content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 Dates & Interview Venue
content_sections.text: The selection process will be carried out at EIL offices in Gurugram, Chennai, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Vadodara , applicable to all three position codes (A, B and C). The exact date, time, and venue will be communicated individually to eligible, registered candidates. Note: Candidates who have not submitted their online registration will not be entertained at the interview. Only candidates who registered online and report with a printout bearing a valid registration number will be considered.

rows.date_time: Not fixed in the notification; will be intimated separately to registered candidates via registered email

content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Note: The specified qualification must have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. Eligibility (qualification, experience, and age) is reckoned as on 31 July 2026.

rows.educational_qualification: BE/B.Tech/B.Sc(Engg.) in Mechanical, min. 60% or equivalent CGPI
rows.relevant_experience: Min. 2 years post-qualification; preferably in Design & Engineering as Mechanical Engineer (piping/pipeline) for Refinery/Petrochemical/Gas Processing/Fertilizer/Chemical plants/Offshore pipelines/Jetty LNG projects, with familiarity in ASME B31.4/B31.8/B31.3/API/ISO/International codes, OISD/PNGRB

rows.relevant_experience: Min. 2 years post-qualification; in Civil/Structural Design of structures related to refineries, pipeline terminals, LPG/LNG terminals, ports, jetties, shipbuilding/repair facilities, offshore fixed platforms and marine structures

rows.educational_qualification: BE/B.Tech/B.Sc(Engg.) in Mechanical/Civil/Ocean/Marine/Naval Architecture, min. 60% or equivalent CGPI
rows.relevant_experience: Min. 2 years post-qualification; similar to Position A (Design & Engineering experience for oil/gas pipelines, piping systems, relevant codes)

content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Engineer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: There is no written test. Selection is through screening followed by a Personal Interview. On the day of the interview, applications and certificates are first screened to confirm eligibility for the post applied. Only candidates meeting the eligibility requirements in all respects proceed to the Personal Interview. Depending on the number of candidates, interviews may run until 8:00 PM on the same day, and may continue the next day if required – candidates must make their own stay arrangements in such cases. Furnishing wrong or false information is a ground for disqualification; EIL will not be responsible for any resulting disqualification. The selected candidate will be allowed to join only if found medically fit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the career link on the EIL website: http://www.engineersindia.com Read all instructions on the website carefully before proceeding. Fill in the online form with correct details. Round the percentage of marks down to the nearest whole number (e.g., 60.9% → 60), and round CGPA down to one decimal (e.g., 6.95 → 6.9). Keep scanned copies ready before starting registration: a recent passport-size colour photograph (.jpg/.jpeg, max 75 KB) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, max 25 KB). Complete registration between 25 August 2026 and 08 September 2026 (23:59 hrs) . You do not need to send a printout by post. Instead, take a printout of the registered application form ( 6 copies ), affix a colour photograph, and bring these copies to the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at Interview (Original + Self-Attested Photocopy)
content_sections.text: 6 copies of the duly filled, submitted online application form with a recent colour photograph affixed Valid photo ID issued by Govt. of India (Driving Licence/PAN Card/Passport/Voter ID/Aadhaar Card) Date of Birth proof: Matriculation/Class X certificate or Birth Certificate Certificates of educational qualifications: Matriculation/Class X/HSC/Degree/PG mark sheets and passing certificates of all semesters/years Proof of the norms adopted by your University/Institute to convert CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade to percentage (a standard conversion table is used if this proof is unavailable – see note below) Experience certificates (original) for all declared experience, clearly showing date of joining, date of separation, and nature of work handled On demand: offer letter, confirmation order, pay slips, PF statement, ESI card, bank statement, etc., to substantiate employment (especially for candidates presently employed) SC/ST certificate (original, prescribed format), if applicable Valid OBC (NCL) certificate (original, Government of India format), if applicable Valid EWS certificate (original, prescribed format), if applicable Disability certificate (original, prescribed format), if applicable Discharge Certificate, undertaking, and proforma for Ex-Servicemen (prescribed format), if applicable No Objection Certificate (original), for candidates working in/under a Central/State/Autonomous Body Important: In case of non-availability of any original document required to meet the eligibility criteria, the candidate will not be considered for further selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many Associate Engineer posts has EIL notified in 2026?
faq.answer: EIL has notified 12 posts – 6 Pipeline/Piping Engineer, 4 Offshore Structural Engineer, and 2 Project Engineer, all Associate Engineer Grade I.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed-term engagement, initially for 2 years and extendable up to a maximum of 3 years from the date of joining. No claim for regular appointment will be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for online registration for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration closes on 08 September 2026 at 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: At EIL offices in Gurugram, Chennai, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Mumbai, or Vadodara; the exact date, time, and venue will be intimated to registered candidates by email.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for EIL Associate Engineer Grade I?
faq.answer: A consolidated monthly remuneration of ₹64,000 in X category cities, ₹60,800 in Y category cities, and ₹57,600 in Z category cities, inclusive of HRA and PF.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum experience required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years of relevant post-qualification experience, as detailed for each position in the Eligibility section.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a written test for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, selection is based on screening of applications/certificates followed by a Personal Interview only.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for EIL Associate Engineer posts?
faq.answer: 32 years as on 31 July 2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and additional relaxation for PwD and Ex-Servicemen categories.
